items.title: Everest Group (EG) Completes Latin America Insurance Exit With Chile And Colombia Deals
items.summary: Everest Group (NYSE:EG) agreed to sell its Chile insurance operations to AIG, finalizing its retreat from Latin American commercial retail insurance. AIG also completed its purchase of Everest Group's Colombia insurance business, closing out Everest's remaining retail footprint in the region. items.title: Everest Group (EG) Faces Reserve Lawsuit, Is The Stock Slightly Overvalued?
items.summary: Everest Group (NYSE:EG) is back in focus after a new securities class action accused the insurer of understating casualty reserves and misrepresenting risk exposure, just as fresh quarterly earnings and reserve moves reshape the story for shareholders. items.title: EG Q3 deep dive: reserve strengthening and underwriting discipline mark Everest’s transition phase
items.summary: Global reinsurance company Everest Group (NYSE:EG) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales falling 14% year on year to $3.71 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.62 per share was 4.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
